reviews.title: Doesn’t care about the grammar; has OPINIONS; slows everything down
reviews.text:
- Doesn’t “see” a simple typo
- Doesn’t mark an awkward verb form
- Doesn’t mark an absent word.

What it does?
- Insists on semicolon
- Insists on “stronger verbs”
- Suggests “premium edits” on the level of the whole phrase and sometimes even rewrites my text, unprompted.


I’ve been using Grammarly on my devices since 2017 or something close to that. My English level is close to fluency, on the level of expression, but I can make some silly mistakes on the level of articles, some verb form, and prepositions. Years ago, Grammarly was definitely a tool to support my needs. Now? Completely unreliable. Even more, it slow downs the performance of my iPhone and recently, it started editing/adding random words to my writing. This is completely inappropriate. Time to let it go.

Theoretically it is very good, but fails to achieve its goals in a number of ways.
1. Destroys the writer’s voice by needlessly changing words and expecting a character’s speech to be grammatically correct. Not always realistic.
2. Customer support is very poor, failing to give correct information to solve problems. I have wasted days trying to install your software without success. Succeed eventually by experimentation, then discover the software I have subscribed to has been retired 2weeks later. 
	Have been a subscriber for 4 or 5 years, but seriously thinking of giving it up. When it comes to problems, enough is enough.

reviews.title: 3 free rewrites when they used to be free is ridiculous
reviews.text: I am writing my own story, and I am using Grammarly to lengthen certain sections of the book, but when I go to select the text I WANT the app decides to ignore my selected text and begins to rework a section of text that I DO NOT NEED reworked. So I have to completely copy and paste the text I WANT into a new folder and because I had pressed the “rewrite” button twice before but didn't go through with it because the app wasn't doing what I wanted it do do, I could only rephrase it ONE time because the stupid app didn't know what I wanted it to prompt EVEN THOUGH I HAVE ALREADY SELECTED THE TEXT I WANTED REWRITTEN, the app decides that “Oh no you've already used all your free rewrites today!” when I only used one. This is an issue with the app that is so frustrating that I'm canceling my subscription on my other devices and deleting the app. This is ridiculous. I shouldn't have to paste over a whole separate paragraph just to get THAT one changed. The app should not automatically select the whole document just to try and rewrite the incorrect paragraph! This is unacceptable and quite frankly you have lost a user, permanently.

reviews.title: Keyboard Only Plan Would Be a Game Changer
reviews.text:
I’ve used Grammarly Premium for several years during university, mainly for long essays and projects. Now that I no longer need those features, the full Grammarly ecosystem no longer makes sense for me.

What does make sense is the mobile keyboard. However, bundling it with the full web and desktop suite makes the pricing unreasonable: £125 yearly, £55 quarterly, or £28 monthly is excessive for someone who only uses the phone keyboard for texting and occasional notetaking.

Grammarly should separate the keyboard from the rest of the writing tools. A simple keyboard only subscription at £5–£10 per month would be far more appropriate. It wouldn’t even need AI features, just solid grammar and sentence structure corrections, especially for users whose first language isn’t English.

reviews.title: If it’s not broken, don’t fix it
reviews.text: What’s the old adage if it ain’t broken don’t fix it. Grammarly should’ve taken a lesson from that. The latest update is horrible. They’ve added AI functionality. That is completely unusable. I’ve been subscribed to Grammarly for since it first came on the scene back around 2018 back then it was a simple AutoCorrect app which I found extraordinarily useful on my day-to-day life as I write a lot of emails and sometimes get bogged down in what I need to say in a concise manner that my clients can understand. As the years went on, the app only got better by adding prove it and different writing conversational styles which I would sometimes use it depending on my individual need the recent update however has been away with those features completely. If they’re there they’re hidden I don’t know where to find Them now instead the AI makes stupid suggestions that are irrelevant to what I’m trying to achieve. I don’t need AI in my life this way I’d much rather have driver assist than auto pilot any day. Guys put it back the way it was please.

reviews.title: Glitches/ Has people thinking I’m from Appalachia. ⛰️🥸
reviews.text: The app is Meh… so/so……. Its definitely not worth the price. It glitches constantly. It also forces words to be misspelled or misinterpreted when I’m typing out the correctly spelled word. When I’m typing out my sentences or words, I look to see what word I will finish with because this app makes it a fun surprise! (Note, I always look at what words are being typed out I’m just saying I take an extra step or precautionary measureIt will force it to be a different word all together sometimes (by forcing I mean as I’m typing out, let’s say “are you going to the mall?” It will type out “are yuo join the mall?” And I am typing out the word correctly, but it changes the letters. Whatevs…. Sometimes, it works just as intended, but then when that’s the case it makes my phone lag, horribly.  I have an iPhone Air, maybe it’s something with the new phones, idk, but I got alot of storage on this phone and tons of memory. It’s got my words and sentences sound like a babbling country grandpa from the Appalachian mountains.
